excerpt: A significant positive correlation was found between shifts away from hard-materialism (the NPB factor) and changes in well-being. The correlation was significant at 4 weeks and at 6 months post-ceremony. Figure 3 states that shifts away from hard materialistic beliefs are associated with increases in well-being.
overview: This figure-level and text-level evidence connects metaphysical belief change to psychological outcome, making the findings relevant beyond abstract belief measurement. The evidence establishes association, not whether non-physicalist belief change causes well-being improvement or whether both reflect a wider therapeutic process.
title: Well-Being Association
